subject: Viral clips of President Joe Biden appearing to freeze or wander off at events
called_fake_by: White House Press Secretary Karine Jean-Pierre
claim: Asked about clips of Biden at the G7 and a Los Angeles fundraiser, Jean-Pierre called them "cheap fakes" made in bad faith. At one point she also used the word deepfakes.
finding: The clips were real footage, not AI. Fact-checkers found some were cropped or framed misleadingly; in the G7 clip, Biden was turning to a skydiver who was out of frame. Whether the clips fairly showed his condition was disputed.
outcome: Ten days later, the June 27 debate intensified concern about Biden's fitness. He withdrew from the race in July 2024.

sources.title: 'Cheap fake' videos, and the phrase itself, take 2024 election's center stage
